pie: wékʷos toy h₁sónt? wékʷos moy h₁sónt. bʰoydʰéh₂m toy dédeh₃mi. deywṓs tód ḱluwih₁ént. nu toy bʰebʰóydʰh₂e.
english: Is your word true? My word is true. I give you a pledge. May the gods hear it! Then I trust you.

pie: kéh₂nmn̥ memónth₂e h₁yód dʰǵʰyés séngʷʰome. h₁íd memónh₂e. h₁íd h₂ew séngʷʰōmes. wékʷesh₂ ne memónh₂e. h₁íh₂ toy sokʷéyōh₂. ḱl̥nudʰí.
english: Do you remember the song which we sang yesterday? I remember it. Let us sing it again! I do not remember the words. Let me say them to you. Listen!

pie: kʷíd wékʷsperoy dʰédʰeh₁si? wékʷsperoy ph₂wéni h₁épi sédyomes. bʰréh₂tēr moy séngʷʰeti suHnéwes-kʷe moy ḱl̥nwénti. kʷíd séngʷʰeti? h₂n̥rṓm ḱléwesh₂ séngʷʰeti.
english: What do you do in the evening? In the evening we sit at the fire. My brother sings, and my sons listen. What does he sing? He sings the fames of men.

pie: túH kéh₂ntōr? h₁eǵóh₂ ne kéh₂ntōr. swésōr moy wékʷsperoy gʷéHyeti h₂óweyes-kʷe h₁íh₂m̥ ḱléwsonti. h₂óweyes sméyn̥ti? ne sméyn̥ti légʰyonti-kʷe.
english: Are you a singer? I am not a singer. My sister sings in the evening, and the sheep listen to her. Do the sheep laugh? They do not laugh; they lie down.

pie: kúdʰe sóh₂wl̥ nékʷti h₁éymi? sóh₂wl̥ dʰéǵʰōm Hn̥dʰér h₁éyti. nu h₂éwsōs h₁íd h₂ew wédʰeti. tód h₁sónt? méh₂tēr moy tód wérh₁t.
english: Where does the sun go at night? The sun goes under the earth. Then Dawn leads it back again. Is that true? My mother said that.

pie: kʷóti h₂stéres dyéwi h₁sénti? ne kʷis wóyde. méh₂tēr moy mléwHti h₂stéres diwés gʷówes. kʷís h₁íns péh₂sti? lówksneh₂ h₁íns péh₂sti.
english: How many stars are in the sky? No one knows. My mother says: the stars are the cattle of Sky. And who shepherds them? The Moon shepherds them.

pie: kʷíd mn̥yéth₂er? bʰréh₂term̥ moy mn̥yóh₂er. h₃rēǵés ḱóymom gʷéh₂t h₂ew-kʷe ne gʷegʷóme. moḱs h₂ew gʷm̥yéh₁t. wékʷesbʰos toy bʰebʰóydʰh₂e.
english: What are you thinking of? I am thinking of my brother. He went to the king's village, and he has not come back. May he come back quickly! I trust your words.

pie: deywós wérunos diwés km̥tá gʷah₂t.
english: The god Werunos came down from heaven.

pie: kʷíd smḗysi? suHnús moy dʰǵʰyés ǵn̥h₁yéto. ḱḗr moy mówdoh₁ pl̥nh₁tór. gʷíh₃woyh₁t h₂uksyéh₁t-kʷe. gʷm̥dʰí ph₃dʰí-kʷe.
english: Why are you laughing? Yesterday a son was born to me! My heart fills with joy. May he live and grow up! Come and drink!

pie: kʷís pérkʷunos? h₁éy méǵh₂s deywós. gʷʰént h₁ógʷʰim h₂ḱm̥néh₁ wédōr-kʷe h₁nédʰt. h₁ím dedwóyth₂e? h₁ím dedwóyh₂e gʷṓs-kʷe nos h₂lékseti.
english: Who is Perkunos? He is a great god. He slew the serpent with a stone, and the waters came forth. Do you fear him? I fear him, and he protects our cattle.

pie: eḱwos wewekur, "ḱludʰe, owei! ḱerd angʰetai widontbʰyos: ǵʰm̥on, potis, wl̥nam owiyōm kʷr̥neti soi gʷʰermom westrom; owibʰyos kʷe wl̥nā ne esti".
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: kʷíd lówksneh₂? lówksneh₂ nékʷts léwks. dyéwi stéygʰeti sóh₂wl̥-kʷe sékʷetor. h₁íd h₁r̥h₁pyéti? h₁íd ne h₁r̥h₁pyéti. nu h₁íd h₂ew séh₂gyeti.
english: What is the moon? The moon is the light of the night. She walks in the sky and follows the sun. Does she seize it? She does not seize it. So she tracks it again.

pie: kʷís h₂stérn̥s h₂én dʰéh₁t? ne wóydh₂e. bʰréh₂tēr moy sokʷéyesi deywṓs h₁íns dʰh₁ént. kúdʰe h₁éyes ǵn̥h₁yónto? polh₁úh₂ prḗḱs. bʰréh₂term̥ moy préḱsdʰi.
english: Who placed the stars there? I do not know. My brother says: the gods placed them. And where were they born? You have asked many things! Ask my brother!

pie: deywóybʰos nos ḱlush₁yónti? deywṓs nos ḱlush₁yónti h₁yód h₁éymos kh₂nómes. dʰrówgʰom ne ḱlush₁yónti. nu h₁sónth₂ wékʷesh₂ bʰéh₂oh₂.
english: Do the gods hear us? The gods hear us when we chant to them. They do not listen to a lie. Then let me speak true words.

pie: ḱéywe moy h₂roh₁dʰéye. ḱléwsoh₂. wórmos bʰólyom bʰéret. nu súHs gʷémt h₁íd-kʷe h₂éḱh₃t. wórmos HréwdHt. nu kʷíd wórmos dʰéh₁t? néwom bʰólyom h₂isḱét.
english: Speak to me, dear one! I am listening. An ant was carrying a leaf. Then a pig came and ate it up. The ant was crying out. Then what did the ant do? It was looking for a new leaf.

pie: kʷíh₁ ḱód mléwHmi? nókʷtm̥ dedwóyh₂e. nókʷtm̥ dedwóyh₂e. méh₂trey toy ḱód skʷdʰí. h₁íh₂ te h₂lékseti.
english: How do I say this? I fear the night. I fear the night. Say this to your mother! She protects you.

pie: kʷís deywṓm ph₂tḗr? dyḗws h₁éysōm ph₂tḗr dʰéǵʰōm-kʷe méh₂tēr. dyḗws dʰǵʰémi h₁épi légʰet. nu h₂éwsōs gʷémt Héh₂mr̥-kʷe léwkt. nu ǵnéh₃m̥.
english: Who is the father of the gods? Sky is their father, and Earth is their mother. Sky was lying on Earth. Then Dawn came, and the daylight grew bright. Now I understand.

pie: sméymn̥ moy wéwke. súHh₁e h₃rēǵés ḱóymom gʷéh₂t. h₃rḗǵs wéwket kʷís túH. súHs h₂éǵt h₁eǵóh₂ toy néwos h₃rḗǵs. néwos h₃rḗǵs.
english: Tell me a joke! A pig went to the king's home. The king said: who are you? The pig said: I am your new king! A new king!

pie: h₂ówis h₁éḱwōs-kʷe
english: The Sheep and the Horses

pie: kʷís toy dóḱtōr h₁ést? méh₂tēr me kéh₂nmn̥h₂ doḱéyet. swésōr moy ḱlutós kéh₂ntōr. h₁ésyeh₂s moy kéh₂nmn̥ kh₂né. nu h₂ḱh₂owsyé.
english: Who was your teacher? Mother taught me songs. My sister is a famous singer. Sing me her song! Then listen well!

pie: kʷíd deywóybʰos mléwHsi? mléwHmi déywōs moy gʷṓs h₂ówins-kʷe ph₂sté. nu h₁éymos h₁erkʷóm dédeh₃mi. ḱlush₁yónti te? ḱlush₁yónti me gʷówes-kʷe moy pléh₁dʰontor.
english: What do you say to the gods? I say: Gods, guard my cows and sheep! Then I give them a hymn. Do they hear you? They hear me, and my cattle increase.

pie: kʷíh₁ ḱód bʰéh₂mi? ḱémh₂m̥. ḱémh₂m̥. sddʰí ph₃dʰí-kʷe. túH moy ḱéywos.
english: How do I say this? I have grown tired. I have grown tired. Sit down and drink! You are dear to me.

pie: h₂nḗr me dʰréwgʰt. kʷíd h₂éǵt? h₂éǵt ḱós h₁éḱwos HeHḱús. só h₁éḱwos ne drémt. tósyo h₂n̥rés wékʷesh₂ dʰrówgʰōs. h₁ésmey kʷid mē déh₃s.
english: A man deceived me. What did he say? He said: this horse is swift. That horse did not run. The words of that man are lies. Do not give him anything!

pie: kʷíd wiHrṓs h₂isḱónti? wiHrṓs ń̥dʰgʷʰitom ḱléwos h₂isḱónti. m̥rént h₁éysōm-kʷe ḱléwos gʷíh₃weti. kʷíd túH h₂isḱési? gʷṓm moy h₂isḱóh₂. lelóykʷe.
english: What do heroes seek? Heroes seek imperishable fame. They die, and their fame lives. And what do you seek? I seek my cow! She is gone.

pie: dn̥ǵʰwéh₂m me toy doḱéye. wékʷesh₂ moy ḱléwse h₁íh₂-kʷe wérh₁ye. ḱód wódr̥. ḱód péh₂wr̥. h₁éwkm̥.
english: Teach me your tongue! Listen to my words and say them! This is water. This is fire. I have learned!

pie: ph₂tḗr toy h₂eh₂ógʰe? h₂eh₂ógʰe. ǵʰwḗr nos dwóyh₁ h₂ówih₁ gʷʰént. deywṓs h₁ésmey néwās h₂ówins dh₃ih₁ént.
english: Is your father upset? He is upset. A wild beast killed our two sheep. May the gods give him new sheep!

pie: kʷís túH? h₁eǵóh₂ deywóḱlewēs. ph₂tḗr moy ḱód h₁nómn̥ dʰéh₁t. ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥. ḱléwos moy méǵh₂ bʰuHyéh₁t.
english: Who are you? I am Fame-from-the-Gods. My father set this name. A famous name! May my fame become great!

pie: swópniyom nékʷti widóm. kʷíd widés? wĺ̥kʷōys me sékʷeto. bʰéyh₂m̥. mē bʰéyh₂s. swópniyom ne wĺ̥kʷos. swópniyosyo kʷim wĺ̥kʷos ne h₁ḗdti.
english: I saw a dream in the night. What did you see? A wolf was following me. I became afraid. Do not be afraid! A dream is not a wolf. The wolf of a dream eats no one.
